heart-size.$description: The heart's circle, centred in its touch target.

fact-gap.$description: A fact's icon to its text.

faded-opacity.$description: What a closed restaurant fades (U6); its state chip and the heart keep their full contrast.

cover.$description: The tint behind a missing cover.

heart-favourite.$description: A favourite's Bold heart: the shape changes too, not the colour alone (R4).
